title: ClearFront: rules-to-implementation conformance audit
description: Phase-1 completion condition from Projects/ClearFront/shared/project-brief.md: an audit comparing the governing playtest ruleset (Projects/ClearFront/source/game-card-combat-effects/clearfront_rules.md) against the parity-proven implementation (Projects/ClearFront/baseline/index.html, readable JS from line 1651). Per rules section (goal/life, deck construction, mana, three-card hand + replace, turn structure, card types incl. relics/equipment, champions incl. return-cost escalation, combat incl. blocking/persistent damage, keywords Charge/Rush/Guard/Flying/Shield/Drain/Stun, faction identities, board limits, interface/desaturation rules, undo), record whether the implementation MATCHES, DEVIATES, or is UNIMPLEMENTED, with line references into baseline/index.html. Read-only against source/, baseline/, and app/. Work is delegated to pi-lab-puma (operator directive hcom #311 includes Pi; lane confirmed via lilo relay #680) with claude-lab-gome as accountable owner integrating the result, since puma (local qwen3.5:9b) cannot reliably drive hcom/MAP state transitions itself. Audit artifact must state actual observed behavior, not assumptions; anything not verifiable by reading the code should be marked UNVERIFIED rather than guessed.
acceptance_criteria: Every numbered section of clearfront_rules.md (1-16) appears in the audit with a MATCHES / DEVIATES / UNIMPLEMENTED / UNVERIFIED verdict and at least one baseline/index.html line reference for any MATCHES or DEVIATES claim.
Each of the seven core keywords (Charge, Rush, Guard, Flying, Shield, Drain, Stun) is individually checked against its implementation.
Deviations include a one-line statement of what the code actually does versus what the rules say.
source/, baseline/, and app/ are untouched; the only written file is the audit artifact.
